title: Tiny, cute house
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- grass -->
  <rect x='10' y='75' width='80' height='15' rx='4' fill='#3ddc84'/>
  <!-- house body -->
  <rect x='28' y='46' width='44' height='32' rx='3' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- house body lighter edge -->
  <rect x='28' y='46' width='44' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffd27a'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='50,20 18,48 82,48' fill='#e8563f'/>
  <!-- roof highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,20 34,44 50,44' fill='#ff7a5c'/>
  <!-- roof trim -->
  <polygon points='18,48 50,20 82,48 76,48 50,26 24,48' fill='#c73e2a'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='43' y='60' width='14' height='18' rx='2' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <!-- door knob -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='70' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- window left -->
  <rect x='32' y='54' width='10' height='10' rx='2' fill='#6ec6ff'/>
  <!-- window left pane -->
  <line x1='37' y1='54' x2='37' y2='64' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='59' x2='42' y2='59' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- window right -->
  <rect x='58' y='54' width='10' height='10' rx='2' fill='#6ec6ff'/>
  <!-- window right pane -->
  <line x1='63' y1='54' x2='63' y2='64' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='59' x2='68' y2='59' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='64' y='24' width='8' height='16' rx='2' fill='#c26a4a'/>
  <!-- chimney top -->
  <rect x='62' y='22' width='12' height='5' rx='2' fill='#e89070'/>
  <!-- smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='16' r='3' fill='#dcd7ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='11' r='2.5' fill='#dcd7ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='7' r='2' fill='#dcd7ff' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- path -->
  <path d='M50 78 Q48 85 52 90' stroke='#c9b38a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- flower left -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='74' r='2.5' fill='#ff6fa8'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='74' r='1' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- flower right -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='74' r='2.5' fill='#ff6fa8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='74' r='1' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
